name: BOOT
label: Month 0 · Setup
goal: Environment, keys, and the 20-line tool loop that makes everything else make sense.

weeks.title: Boot sector
weeks.why: You cannot learn LLM engineering while also fighting your environment. Spend this week making the friction zero, then write the 20-line loop that the whole roadmap is layers on top of.

tasks.t: Create the GitHub repo, push this site, enable GitHub Pages (Settings > Pages > branch main, / root)
Get free API keys: Google AI Studio (Gemini, generous free tier), Groq (free + very fast), OpenRouter (has free models)
Install uv (astral) and create a Python 3.12 project. Stop using pip/venv by hand.
Install Ollama, pull llama3.2:3b and nomic-embed-text. You now have a zero-cost local model for unlimited experimentation.
Write the 20-line loop: a script that calls a model, gives it ONE tool that queries your existing Django DB, and loops until it answers. No framework.
Write a baseline note in this site: what you already know, what scares you, what you think an AI Engineer does. You will re-read this in Week 30.
AT WORK: list every workflow at your company that touches unstructured text (support tickets, PDFs, notes, logs, emails). This list is your Month 4 opportunity.

resources.label: Google AI Studio — free Gemini API keys
Groq Console — free, fastest inference available
OpenRouter — one API, many models, some free
uv — the Python package manager to use in 2026
Ollama — run models locally for free
Karpathy — Deep Dive into LLMs like ChatGPT (3.5h, watch across the week)

code.label: basic_agent.py — the loop, written by hand

weeks.deliverable: A repo with a working tool-calling script and a live GitHub Pages site tracking this roadmap.
weeks.checkpoint: Can you explain, without notes, what the model actually returned when it 'called a tool'? (It returned text. You parsed it. You called the function. You sent the result back. That's it.)
